svg.text: Dependent Type Family (a, b) ↦ Gcd(a, b): Input Values Shift the Meet
Within the same ambient divisibility lattice Div(72), changing parameters (a, b) re-indexes the cones and relocates the type's inhabitant.
Dependent Type Signature: Gcd : (a : ℕ) → (b : ℕ) → Type where Gcd(a, b) ≔ { g ∈ ℕ | Div(g) = Div(a) ∩ Div(b) }
Meet lands on the left boundary (×2 axis).
Orthogonal axes meet only at bottom 1
Disjoint prime axes collapse cone to {1}.
Notice: 4 ∈ Gcd(12, 8) is well-typed in Panel 1, but 4 ∉ Gcd(18, 12) and 4 ∉ Gcd(9, 8) — the type itself moves with the values (a, b).
